decision.explanation: Two distinct historical figures named Sarah Anne Page are mentioned in the provided sources. Document d1 describes a modern Sarah Anne Page (born 1975) who married David Norton on June 15, 2002. Document d2 refers to a historical Sarah Anne Page (19th century) who married James fforde. These are separate individuals with the same name, and both marriages are explicitly stated in their respective documents. The requested relation 'spouse' applies directly to each referent in their own context. There is no evidence of a single individual being married to both men, nor any indication of contradiction between the claims.
